capabilities: Track daily habits and projects as blocks on a board
Record confirmations, counts, text, dates, fixed fields and attachments
Write every record back to the matching Markdown note
Review progress in week and month views
Archive projects while keeping their history
extras: Freemium: free tier allows up to 2 projects; a license removes the limit and unlocks future-date planning in the month view. Closed-source; license keys stored in Obsidian SecretStorage and verified locally; no telemetry. Caution: do not publish .obsidian/plugins/square/data.json. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; license keys sold via Xiaohongshu.
problem: Obsidian has no visual board for daily habit and project check-ins, and standalone habit apps lock the data away from your notes.
summary: Grid-based habit and project tracker that records daily check-ins into Markdown notes, with week and month review views.
